verdict.rationale: Vapi documents an organization-wide HIPAA compliance mode that you turn on in the Dashboard. It restricts you to approved LLM, voice, and transcriber providers and controls how call recordings and logs are stored, so the HIPAA part of regulated workloads is directly supported. Nothing in the evidence covers SOC 2, a BAA, or data-residency options. Missing for 10: SOC 2 attestation evidence, explicit BAA availability, data-residency/region selection options, independent corroboration of the HIPAA mode.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can run regulated workloads with HIPAA/BAA support, SOC 2, and data-residency options

citations.quote: HIPAA compliance can be ensured by turning on HIPAA compliance in the Dashboard.
Enable organization-wide compliance mode, use approved LLM, voice, and transcriber providers, and control how call recordings and logs are stored.
